notes: I changed the ordinary rule's boundary from `x>=0` to `x>0`: E22 shows f(0)=-1 (floor(0)-1), not +1. Positive and negative non-integers are unaffected, but x=0 now correctly gives -1. I also tightened the special interval to `[33.45, 42.035)` based on E20 (42.03 special, 42.04 ordinary) and E18/E22.
